panels.title: Solve stragglers in flight
panels.description: Successor of the retired degenbot_drain_queue_depth gauge (DispatchOwner era, removed SZJUKL): detached-solve straggers awaiting the sidecar merge. Sits at 0 healthy; sustained non-zero is backpressure, cap 8 = wedged (see the DegenbotDrainerStall alert).

panels.title: State head lag (blocks)
panels.description: pool_state_head minus the engine clock (pump clock). Healthy runs sit around -1 (pools sit one block behind the still-open current block). A freeze drives it MORE NEGATIVE as the clock advances on headers while pools stop applying - 0/positive is a restart/coverage artifact, not the freeze. See the pump liveness row for the real freeze signal.

panels.title: Header → published (p95 5m)
panels.description: The epoch race (ADR-041 §3.1): header accept → Published-stage dispatch, the edge where submission/delivery subscribe. Succeeds the retired drain-era "Block-to-solve" stat — solve is no longer the race endpoint (degenbot_block_header_to_solved family retired with the stage machine; hard cutover).

panels.title: Epoch stale-drop share (5m)
panels.description: Share of solve cycles whose work was dropped as a stale epoch (I3 reorg-flying fail-fast, degenbot_epoch_stale_drops) — chronic stage-cycle spillover into the next header that the p95 tail alone hides. Sits at 0 healthy; sustained non-zero means publishes are chronically racing the next header.

panels.title: State head lag (state - clock)
panels.description: pool_state_head - engine clock over time. Healthy = -1 (a thin, stable line; it may dip to 0 when a block tombstones, i.e. a coverage gap, and jump positive for a few points after a restart/missed apply). The freeze is a *sustained climb more negative*, paired with rising apply-age and solve stalls - not a single level.

panels.title: Solve straggler backlog (detached in-flight)
panels.description: Successor of the retired degenbot_drain_queue_depth (SZJUKL): per-epoch queue age now rides the degenbot.stage.* SPANS (queue.age_us attr); degenbot_detached_in_flight is the surviving metric backpressure gauge for the sidecar merge.

panels.title: Pipeline phase durations (p95): decode / apply / publish cycle
panels.description: queue-wait column replaced: degenbot_drain_queue_wait_seconds is retired (SZJUKL); per-epoch queue age rides the degenbot.stage.* span attrs (queue.age_us), and degenbot_stage_publish_cycle_seconds owns the cycle view.

panels.title: Throughput: blocks / logs received / logs applied
Solver load: registered paths / solves / candidates
Liveness: state head lag (freeze signature)
panels.description: Drain-queue target removed: degenbot_drain_queue_depth is retired (SZJUKL). Pump-side liveness is owned by the stage telemetry (degenbot.stage.* spans) and the header-age / apply-age gauges in the next panel.

panels.title: Liveness: header age + apply age (sit at 0; a freeze climbs them)
panels.description: Seconds since the newest newHeads header (feed liveness) and since the newest log applied to state (apply liveness). Healthy = both pinned at ~0. A feed stall lifts the header age; a drain freeze lifts the apply age while the header age stays low and head-lag goes negative. Red at >=30s is a genuine freeze window.

panels.title: Detached cycle: stragglers in flight + applied vs stale-dropped
Solver audit: solver clamps
panels.description: The verify-blocks / state-checks series (degenbot_solver_verify_blocks_total / degenbot_solver_state_checks_total) are RETIRED (MROOY7 2UVG3E): the ADR-021 per-solve tripwire is gone and solver-state verification is on-demand (sim-failure-armed divergence probe). Desync containment surfaces via degenbot_errors_total and the degenbot_engine_quarantined_pools gauge; per-block verify context rides the degenbot.epoch / degenbot.stage.* spans.

panels.title: Dispatch economics: mean gross / net (wei) + gas
Trace view: how to read the solve span tree

options.content:
## Jaeger drill-down - span tree (stage-table shape, BF43PM/AJIOCU)

    degenbot.epoch                  (trace ROOT per block epoch: epoch.block, epoch.seq,
    |                                pregap.logs / header_to_first_log_us / log_burst_us / settle_wait_us)
    +-- degenbot.stage.streaming     (open: first relevant log -> quiesce; queue.age_us at close)
    +-- degenbot.stage.quiesced      (point: quiesce transition)
    +-- degenbot.arb.solve           (solver cycle - fanout / lpt / resolve / path / merge children unchanged)
    +-- degenbot.stage.publish       (point: publish decision; metric degenbot_stage_publish_cycle_seconds)
    +-- degenbot.stage.finalize      (point: epoch finalized)
    Rewind epochs hold degenbot.stage.rewind OPEN across the reorg window (metrics
    degenbot_stage_rewind_total / degenbot_stage_rewind_duration_seconds); the next epoch
    root carries epoch.seq + 1.

**Jaeger queries** (service `degenbot-bot`, host `host.docker.internal:16686`):

- Epoch waterfall: `operation=degenbot.epoch&limit=20&lookback=1h`
- Stage transitions: `operation=degenbot.stage.streaming` / `degenbot.stage.publish` / `degenbot.stage.finalize` (attrs `stage.from`, `stage.to`, `queue.age_us`)
- Phase attribution: the `fanout` / `lpt` / `resolve` / `merge` children of a solve trace (unchanged)
- Rewind story: read `epoch.seq` across epoch roots - a bumped seq is the reorg generation
- RETIRED spans (BF43PM/AJIOCU, epic MROOY7): `degenbot.pump.block` / `pump.log_wait` / `pump.apply_stream` are discontinued

The **Header → published** panels are the epoch race (ADR-041 §3.1): header
accept → Published-stage dispatch, where submission/delivery subscribe. The
retired drain-era header→solved stamp measured the solve endpoint; a solve that
completes but publishes after the next header's accept shows up in the
**Epoch stale-drop share** stat, not the p95. The Engine-Mutex hold panel is
RETIRED (§3.4): the engine Mutex left the solve path with the stage machine.
The **Detached cycle** panel is the sidecar-merge health (Q1a): in-flight is the
un-merged-straggler backpressure gauge (cap 8), and stale-dropped stragglers are
EXPECTED under pool churn - a sustained drop rate with zero applied means the
sidecar pipe is wedged.

panels.title: Stage-cycle gap: delivery / burst / settle / streaming-age (p50/p95)

options.description: Pre-solve gap decomposition (phases recorded at each settle point): header-to-first-log = WS delivery latency; log_burst = diffusion of the block logs across the feed (first-to-last); settle_wait = debounce/quiesce hold after the last log; streaming_age = first relevant log → quiesce (the epoch-stage wait, degenbot.stage.streaming_age). Jaeger: the same values ride as span fields (header_to_first_log_us, log_burst_us, settle_wait_us, queue.age_us) on the degenbot.epoch trace root.

panels.title: Pre-solve gap means vs header-to-published (mean dissolve)

options.description: Mean phase durations vs the total epoch race. delivery + burst + settle + solve should approximately equal header-to-published (ADR-041: the race ends at the Published edge); a residual means unbudgeted time (resolve/simulate/gate queueing, submit queue).

panels.title: Quarantine transitions (30m)
panels.description: ADR-040 quarantine/release transitions in the last 30m. SUCCESSOR of the retired solver_state_desync errors kind: the ADR-021 per-solve publish tripwire was retired with MROOY7 task 2UVG3E, and containment now lives in the resolve-seam quarantine gate (degenbot_engine_quarantined_pools, maintained by BotState::quarantine_pool / release_pool). The bot keeps trading its other paths; the DegenbotDesyncQuarantine alert pages while any containment is active.

panels.title: Quarantined pools (solve-invisible)
panels.description: ADR-040: pools currently quarantine-excluded from solve resolution. PROMETHEUS NAME COUPLING with instruments.rs (degenbot.engine.quarantined_pools).

panels.title: Epoch work: headers vs solve cycles vs candidates (rate/s)

options.description: Rewind frequency (one per EnterReorg) and unwind-window duration p95 (degenbot.stage.rewind_duration). The drain-era liveness role of these panels is the degenbot.epoch trace root with bumped epoch.seq.
